summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the missing primary Table 1 MIC matrix for Pagoamide A, reconciled APD6/DBAASP rows without hiding citation and modified-sequence conflicts, and replaced the mechanism placeholder with a bounded no-direct-mechanism adjudication.
source_review_depth: paper_xml primary Table 1 and article metadata reviewed
paper_pdf text checked against XML table and antimicrobial method
oa_package DataSheet1/DataSheet2 PDFs and archive members reviewed
supplementary_assets landing .bin files inspected; no extra table-bearing supplement found outside OA package PDFs
merged_database_rows APD6/DBAASP sequence, literature, and assay rows reviewed

materials_exhausted.note: All local sources relevant to the worker-2/4/6 blockers were opened. OA package DataSheet PDFs did not add activity/toxicity rows beyond Table 1; supplementary landing .bin assets were HTML landing pages rather than structured tables.

semantic_quality_checks.publication_grade_acceptance_basis: accepted_with_cautions after row-level source repair and conflict-preserving database adjudication

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP current-paper literature link is source verified; DBAASP/APD6 activity rows match primary Table 1 values but carry prior-paper citation context, so they are preserved as source_conflict. APD6 modified sequence remains sequence_modified_not_normalized.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Nine primary-source MIC records were recovered from XML Table 1/PDF text with raw μg/mL units, target species/strains, conditions, and locators. Bare greater-than cells were resolved to >64 μg/mL using the table footnote.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: No direct molecular antimicrobial mechanism assay is locally supported; final mechanism artifact states that limitation and preserves structure/identity context without overclaim.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: Framework-test failures are repaired; remaining issues are caution-level database/provenance limitations rather than blocking or major QC failures.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6/DBAASP database activity rows carry Table 1-compatible values but point to the prior discovery citation; primary XML/PDF Table 1 is authoritative for this paper.
Pagoamide A is a modified cyclic depsipeptide; database residue strings were not converted into a normalized linear sequence.
OA package DataSheet PDFs and landed supplementary HTML/landing assets were checked; no additional source-supported activity/toxicity table was recovered beyond Table 1.
The paper supports antimicrobial screening and synthesis/identity confirmation, but no direct antimicrobial mode-of-action assay.
